name: itcmtest
description: No-op test of ITCM hooks: the Chance FX's random call and the count-in's playback start go through ITCM stubs to hooks that only count the calls; the firmware plays as stock

itcm_branches.note: seq_process_track, Chance FX pre-pass: bl rand_range_q 0x3af4 -> mt_it_chance(lo, hi, column record, track)
seq_tick, end of a count-in: bl seq_play_from 0x1250 -> mt_it_play_from(seq, step)
